name: Mystic Ville
source:
After your pitiful demise, you have been given a second chance to live again by a goofball of a Deity named Misty. But there's a catch! You can never live in the same world ever again! So you have to start fresh again in another world and obviously in another town!

Welcome to the town of Mystic Ville!

Meet strange new people and get to know them, maybe they're keeping some secrets that you might wanna find out!

Who knows? Maybe a vampire is in town?

Wait a minute... how come you have Misty's magical power now? She's not going to take this lightly... you know? 

With her power, your life now has never been easier than before.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/mysticville]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
在你不幸去世后，一个名叫米斯蒂的傻瓜给了你第二次重生的机会。但有一个问题！你们永远不能再生活在同一个世界了！所以你必须在另一个世界，显然是在另一个城镇，重新开始！

欢迎来到神秘城小镇！

结识陌生的新朋友并了解他们，也许他们保守着一些你可能想知道的秘密！

谁知道？也许镇上有吸血鬼？

等一下……你怎么现在就有了小霞的魔力？她不会掉以轻心……你知道吗？

有了她的力量，你现在的生活将变得前所未有的轻松。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/mysticville]Patreon[/url]]
